description.narrative: This project will reinforce capacities of the Government of Tunisia, especially the National Commission against Trafficking in Persons, to better identify and provide adequate care to victims of trafficking. International Organization for Migration (IOM) will achieve this goal by enhancing the capacities of the government to identify, assist, and protect victims of trafficking based on anti-trafficking legislation, through a national training program on protection and assistance to victims of trafficking. This will be achieved through workshops for government and civil society officials, as well as for Embassies and Consular representatives based in Tunisia, especially from sub-Saharan countries. Finally, IOM aims to increase access to adequate protection services for victims of trafficking by providing material support (donations, refurbishment, and equipment support) to the Ministry of Social Affairs shelters for vulnerable populations. This will be achieved through direct assistance services (case management services and access to shelter, medical, and psychosocial services, legal support services, transport, and reintegration) for victims of trafficking, including national and international cases as needs arise.
